caption: The drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil on a lightly toned background. It features a single object centered within a large rectangular border. The object is a lidded vessel or container with a rounded, bulbous body that tapers toward the top and bottom. The upper section has a dome-shaped lid with small holes and a slight rim beneath it. The vessel sits on a short, circular pedestal foot. Near the bottom left corner, a smaller, simplified outline sketch of the same vessel appears within a square frame. The artist's signature, "Leni Amino," and a date are present in the lower right corner inside the main border. The bottom right outside the border contains the initials "B.M." The drawing focuses on shading and contour to depict the smooth, reflective surface of the vessel.
title: Silver Caster
